name: @zhizhu/playwright-rule-schema
description: 知竹：自动化规则 DSL 类型 + 浅校验，客户端编辑器与 Runner 解释器、API 上传校验共用

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const cp=require('node:child_process');const hasTsc=(()=>{try{return !!require.resolve('typescript/bin/tsc')}catch{return false}})();if(!hasTsc){console.log('[playwright-rule-schema] skip build: typescript not installed');process.exit(0);}cp.execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});"
